purpose: Summarize clean reference F1 and recorded model cost from the completed 50 case RQ2 repair run.
nonempty_reference_case: A nonempty reference case has reference_size greater than 0 at the initial controlled graph.
primary_f1_cohort: Primary clean reference F1 uses only the nonempty reference cases.
reference_f1_interpretation: Clean reference F1 compares the current graph to the controlled clean graph as sets. It is not human source faithfulness and not Text2KGBench benchmark F1.
empty_reference_f1_convention: F1 of 0 for a nonempty prediction against an empty reference is only an explicit computational convention. It is not the primary graph quality estimate for those cases.
empty_reference_metric: For empty reference cases the quality metric is the number of extra triples, not F1. Exact empty graph recovery means the last validated graph has size 0.
paired_change: For each nonempty reference case, F1 at the last validated graph minus F1 at round 0. Report n, mean initial precision recall and F1, mean last validated precision recall and F1, the mean and median paired F1 delta, and how many cases improved, stayed the same, or worsened. The mean uses a case bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 42. The overall interval resamples within each of the four included error conditions. The condition and domain intervals resample within that group.
bootstrap_interpretation: This interval describes sensitivity to resampling the controlled cases. It is not a population confidence interval.
all_case_convention_based_summary: This summary uses all 50 cases. It includes the 10 empty reference domain_range cases. F1 of 0 for a nonempty prediction against an empty reference is only an explicit computational convention. It is not the primary graph quality estimate.
transition_change: For every pair of consecutive validated graphs in a nonempty reference case, F1 of the later graph minus F1 of the earlier graph. A round with an output failure has no graph and is skipped. The repair transition number is the later round index.
survivor_round_summaries: Round means include only the nonempty reference cases that still had a validated graph at that round. They do not track a fixed set of cases at every round.
survivor_round_warning: A lower mean F1 at later rounds does not mean that extra rounds made the graphs worse. The later means include only the cases that were still running.
available_from_trajectories: triples for every validated graph, by round
repair prompt_eval_count, eval_count, and total_duration_ns for every repair generation including output failures
grounding prompt_eval_count, eval_count, and total_duration_ns on source=repair_round judgments
end to end stop_reason, validated_state, and output_failure type
unavailable: end to end wall clock runtime
token counts for cached frozen_clean and frozen_injected grounding judgments
grounding_cost_rule: Count a grounding assessor generation once per case for each triple whose stored judgment has source repair_round and recorded token fields. Later listings of the same cached judgment are not additional calls.
time_rule: Recorded model time is Ollama total_duration_ns. Repair model time and live grounding assessor time are summed separately. Their sum is recorded model time, not wall clock runtime.
output_failure_rule: A round with an output failure has no validated graph. Precision, recall, and F1 are omitted for that round. Those rounds are not treated as F1 of 0. Repair generation tokens and duration remain if present. End to end target resolution follows the runner. Last validated state is reported separately.
aggregation: Case summaries use one last validated value per controlled case. Rows for each round are descriptive and are not independent experimental cases.
